items.title: Bulls are punchless in 35-14 loss at FAU
items.summary: South Florida's downward spiral extended to three straight league losses in a 35-14 loss at Florida Atlantic on Saturday. The game was plagued by weather delays due to lightning in the area, while the Bulls offense looked like it never left Tampa. USF fell to 6-5 on the season while FAU improved to 7-4.
